changelog:
- Initial release of the "moderation" skill, providing structured workflows for content moderation at scale.
- Outlines a four-stage process: clarify context & goals, design approach, implement & validate, and operate & iterate.

summary: Moderation workflows, thresholds, and appeals. Use when handling UGC at scale.
